name: Munitions Resupply Bay
desc: Combat resupply ship: carries %s/%s/%s/%s units of munitions by hull size and sends supply shuttles to friendly ships within %s/%s/%s/%s that are short on ballistic or missile ammo. A shuttle shot down loses its load, and the stock doesn't refill in battle. Not with the Boarding Shuttle Bay or Repair Tender Bay.
short: Sends supply shuttles to refill ballistic and missile ammo of nearby friendly ships from a limited stock.

name: Boarding Shuttle Bay
desc: Launches %s/%s/%s/%s boarding shuttles by hull size, %s marines each, to board and capture enemy ships. Shuttles shot down lose their marines. A new wave every %s seconds. Not with the Munitions Resupply Bay or Repair Tender Bay.
short: Launches shuttles of marines to board and capture enemy ships.

name: Repair Tender Bay
desc: Fleet tender: %s/%s/%s/%s repair drones and %s/%s/%s/%s spare parts by hull size. Drones fly to damaged friendly ships nearby and fix knocked-out reactors, destroyed weapons, dead engines and armor (up to %s of its strength). Each repair uses parts; drones shot down are lost. Doesn't repair itself. Not with the Munitions Resupply Bay or Boarding Shuttle Bay.
short: Sends repair drones to fix destroyed weapons, dead engines and armor on nearby friendly ships.

name: Tug Rig
desc: Tows friendly ships that can't move to a Repair Dock, tender, Supply FOB or supply ship. Towing slows the tug to no less than %s of its speed. In RTS mode, select the tug and right-click the stranded ship.
short: Tows stranded friendly ships to a Repair Dock, tender, Supply FOB or supply ship.

name: Explosive Reactive Armor
desc: Reactive tiles on every armor section: %s/%s/%s/%s charges per section by hull size. A charge stops an HE missile outright or cuts an HE shell's damage by %s. An empty section reloads once, after %s seconds; after that only a tender or Repair Dock rearms it. %s less maneuverable.

name: Composite Armor Replacement
desc: Lighter composite plates: kinetic and HE hits do %s less damage, but the armor is %s lower. %s faster and more maneuverable. Stacks with ERA (the stronger HE cut applies) and Spall Lining.

name: Spall Lining
desc: A liner behind the armor that catches the fragments of a shell trying to break through. Shells penetrate the armor %s less well. The extra weight reduces the ship's maneuverability by %s. Can be combined with Composite Armor Replacement and Explosive Reactive Armor.

name: TCO - Weapon Data
desc: An information readout, with no effect in battle. Lists TCO's numbers for every weapon on this ship, with the ship's hullmods and skills counted: damage per shot, armor penetration and what it pierces, and magazine.

name: Expanded Countermeasures Dispenser
desc: Extra flare magazines and a faster-feeding dispenser. The ship carries %s more flares if it is a frigate, %s more otherwise (normally %s for frigates/destroyers/cruisers/capitals). Flares decoy IR-guided missiles; radar-guided missiles ignore them.

name: IRCCM Package
desc: Hardened seekers for this ship's IR missiles (and its fighters'): they never lose a cold target, and a single flare has at most a %s chance against a cold target and next to none against a hot one. Only a dense blanket of flares (more than %s) still works.

name: Datalink Integration
desc: Shares radar with every other Datalink ship: linked radars add up, and every linked ship can fire on any track the network holds, even with its own radar off.

name: Radar Absorbing Materials
desc: Coats the hull in radar-absorbing layers. The ship's radar cross section is %s smaller, so enemy radars find it %s closer in and radar missiles struggle to keep a track on it, but the soft coating costs %s of its armor and hull.

name: AESA Radar
desc: Replaces the ship's search radar with an active electronically scanned array. Radar power is %s higher, so the ship finds targets of every size %s further out. Makes a good radar picket, especially together with Datalink Integration.

name: Radar Removal
desc: Strips out the ship's search radar to free up ordnance points. The ship has no radar of its own: it detects nothing by radar and has no radar scope. Its radar-guided missiles only launch at targets a friendly radar shares over Datalink Integration. Incompatible with AESA Radar.

name: High-Capacity Shuttles
desc: Strips the boarding shuttles down to carry more troops: each carries %s marines instead of %s, but its armor is %s thinner. The freed space aboard also holds %s more marines. Destroyers and up; requires a Boarding Shuttle Bay. Incompatible with Efficient Boarding Bay.

name: Efficient Boarding Bay
desc: Reorganises the boarding bay to launch more shuttles in each wave: %s / %s / %s / %s shuttles by hull size (%s more), and to turn them around faster: a new wave every %s seconds instead of %s. Destroyers and up; requires a Boarding Shuttle Bay. Incompatible with High-Capacity Shuttles.

name: Compact Security Forge
desc: Gives up %s of the cargo space to a forge that builds security droids to defend the ship against boarders: %s/%s/%s/%s by hull size, each at %s of a marine's strength, with no experience, never boarding. They take losses before your marines and are rebuilt between battles. Not on automated ships.
